_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Wewe ni Mchezaji {player_id} katika mchezo wa LinesOfAction.
Vipande vyako ni '{side}', vipande vya mpinzani ni '{other}'.
Fomu ya kusonga: `[b1b3]` (viwianishi vya chanzo hadi viwianishi vya mwisho). Kusonga kwa sheria husafiri wima, mlalo, au diagonally idadi ya miraba sawa na jumla ya vipande (rangi yoyote) katika mstari huo. Unaweza kuruka juu ya vipande vyako, lakini si vipande vya mpinzani; kutua kwenye mpinzani humkamata.  Ushindi wakati vipande vyote vimeunganishwa kwa 8-jirani.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mĩandĩko nĩyaĩle kwĩthĩwa yĩ mĩaonĩ ya "e2 e4" (kuma,kũka) na "coordinates".
invalid_move.identical: Kĩsese kĩla kĩthĩawa vau vamwe na vala mũndũ ũtwaĩte valũa no nginya ikethĩwa iilyĩ oou.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: No nginya wĩkale ũatĩĩe nzĩa ĩla ũkwenda kũthi nayo.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: No nginya tũsũanĩe ũndũ tũtonya kwĩka nĩ kana mĩsoa ĩsu yĩkaneene nesa.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: Andũ ala mavĩtĩte nĩmeesĩ nzĩa ĩla ĩtonya kũvikĩwa.
invalid_move.destination_own: Mũndũũme ũmwe aĩ na kĩthũi kĩnene.

outcome.draw_repetition: Ĩtambya ya kelĩ: Mbee ĩsiwa na yĩngĩ.
